integrity: Original finite-window diameter table was exhaustively computed from the precise directed shift graph. The general strong-component and constant-vertex diameter statements have self-contained proofs. The binary case of the classical vertex-connectivity theorem is credited to prior literature.
limitations: Exact all-vertex postfailure diameter histograms only for \(2\le k\le10\); no all-k formula. One older historical generalized-digraph source was available at abstract level only, and coverage in unpublished routing tables cannot be excluded.
source_date_evidence: The 2000-04-12 anchor is the independently day-verified first-online date of the closely related baseline fault-routing article by Mao and Yang; older cited print literature is identified by year or season without inventing a day of first public availability.
title: Single-vertex failures in directed binary de Bruijn networks: exact cuts and finite fault diameters
